warnings: After the replacement render completed all 3000 frames and wrote the MP4, the VideoCompose wrapper returned failure because ffprobe was absent from that process PATH. The identical VideoCompose final-review implementation was rerun with the repository-bundled ffprobe and passed; no rerender or runtime substitution was used.

Independent ASR transcript comparison was not run; the approved narration reel, exact source-WAV timings, exact caption-to-script match, and PCM output analysis provide the retained audio verification trail.
verification_notes: Final package audit caught and corrected the prior atelier music fades (2.0s/4.0s) to the approved edit contract (1.5s/2.0s) at 0.16 volume; the master was replaced before delivery.
Pre-render CompositionValidator then passed with 0 errors and 0 warnings for all 9 exact-duration narration assets, 37 captions, and the 104-second music bed.
Actual replacement output passed ffprobe: H.264/AAC, 1920x1080, 30 fps, 100.053 seconds, with a valid audio stream.
Nine replacement-master scene midpoints were inspected at full resolution; no missing stock assets, broken overlays, black scenes, or unreadable primary text were found.
All 8 replacement-master scene boundaries were sampled; the intentional 8-frame/7-frame dip-to-ink transition is present with no missing timeline intervals.
PCM audio QA: peak -4.023 dBFS, RMS -19.887 dBFS, 0 clipped samples, no >750 ms silence below -50 dBFS.
Narration averages -19.58 dBFS while music-only gaps average -38.12 dBFS, preserving intelligibility.
The replacement final mix peak/RMS are within 0.31 dB of the user-approved review reel.
All 37 SRT cues are monotonic, non-overlapping, timing-identical to burned captions, and text-identical to the governed script; coverage ends at 99.214 seconds.
Remotion runtime and atelier composition mode match the approved proposal; no silent runtime swap occurred.

metadata.render_attempt_disposition: Replacement master rendered all 3000 frames. Wrapper post-check PATH failure recovered with bundled ffprobe and the same review implementation.

metadata.intentional_transition_design: Each scene fades from the #071015 ink field over 8 frames and back over 7 frames; exact boundaries are dark editorial beats, not missing timeline content.
metadata.transcript_comparison_disposition: Non-critical: the repository tool received no independent ASR transcript. The user approved the complete narrated review reel; all nine rendered source WAV durations match props, 37 caption cues exactly match the governed script, and supplemental PCM QA confirms narration, music, no clipping, and no unexpected silence.
metadata.atelier_motion_ratio_note: The cut-schema motion-ratio heuristic reports 0.0 because atelier bypasses cut types. The rendered project is an animated Remotion composition; this heuristic is not an atelier-motion measurement.

findings.description: Final packaging audit found that the first accepted MP4 used atelier-hardcoded 2.0s/4.0s music fades rather than the approved 1.5s/2.0s edit values.
findings.agent_response: Exposed volume and fade values as composition props, set them to the governed 0.16/1.5s/2.0s values, passed zero-warning preflight, rendered a replacement master, and reran audio/visual/transition/subtitle QA.

findings.description: The replacement render wrote a complete MP4, but the wrapper post-check could not discover ffprobe on PATH and therefore returned failure after rendering.
findings.agent_response: Reran the identical VideoCompose final-review method with the repository-bundled ffprobe on PATH. The replacement MP4 passed technical review and independent ffprobe; the recovery and raw result are both retained.

findings.description: The automated post-render reviewer had no independent ASR transcript for word-level transcript comparison.
findings.agent_response: Retained this limitation. It does not block delivery because the complete narrated review reel was approved, all nine source WAVs match exact governed durations, all 37 caption cues exactly match the script, and PCM QA confirms narration, music, headroom, and continuity.

findings.description: At each exact scene boundary, the composition reaches the dark ink field before the next scene fades in.
findings.agent_response: This is the authored 8-frame-in/7-frame-out editorial dip-to-ink, not a gap. All eight boundary frames are non-black #071015 ink and timeline timing is continuous.
